note: rustre-ttd-replayer is a workspace library crate (Time-Travel Debugging replayer: TtdTrace, TraceEvent, TraceSnapshot, ReplayState, TtdReplayer with goto/step_forward/step_backward, find_writes, find_root_cause, TraceBuilder, TtdQuery parser, TraceStats, format constants TRACE_MAGIC/HEADER_SIZE/FRAME_SIZE/kind tags). It is NOT exposed via the MCP server: no references to ttd-replayer/TtdReplay in crates/rustre-mcp-tools (grep -i 'ttd[_-]?replay' returns no matches). JSON-RPC stdio comparison against rustre-mcp.exe is therefore N/A; the pure-logic Python validator IS the ground-truth comparison.

checked_against_source.constants: DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL=256, MAX_MEM_WRITES_PER_EVENT=1024, REPLAY_PAGE_SIZE=4096, TRACE_MAGIC=0x0052554E00445454, SUPPORTED_VERSION_MAJOR=2, HEADER_SIZE=128, FRAME_SIZE=32
checked_against_source.TraceSnapshot+ReplayState: page-aligned mem (4096), regs map, program_counter via pc/rip/eip
checked_against_source.TtdReplayer: goto(target_tick), step_forward, step_backward, find_all_writes_to, read_memory_at_tick, find_last_write_before, find_last_write_range_before, reset, remaining_events
